title: UDX catalog dump (api-inventory.json)
description: Jackson’s @udx/lib dump shape. Preferred path: catalog/udx/api-inventory.json (hose from @udx/lib@0.0.82). Skills historically said catalog/udx/components.json; the harness still loads that file (or inventory.catalog.path) as a fallback. Each row is an API: selector may be a string or null. Gate A only accepts status: verified (or equivalent) AND a non-null selector as angularTarget. selector:null / source-only rows (hotkeys, date, close-on-scroll, …) must not be used as angularTarget. Magic Patterns does not produce this file. Never invent rows — paste the dump from @udx/lib. An empty components/apis array disables membership until populated. The loader also accepts a top-level apis (or inventory/items) array.

apis.description: Alternate row collection (api-inventory.json). Loader copies a non-empty apis array onto components.

selector.description: Angular custom-element selector (e.g. udx-button). Null on source-only APIs — those rows cannot be angularTarget.

status.description: verified = eligible angularTarget (with non-null selector). source-only = not an angularTarget. Legacy dumps with a real selector and no status count as verified.

name.description: Human/catalog/API name. Optional aid for matching Magic Patterns source.name. Also used to reject inventory pointers at source-only APIs (hotkeys, date, close-on-scroll).

react.description: Magic Patterns / React component name this selector maps from (e.g. Button).

inputs.description: Allowed input names → allowed values (variants). Object form: { "variant": ["primary", "secondary"], "size": ["sm", "md"] }. A CSV dump may flatten this to inputs + variants columns.

variants.description: Optional alias when inputs are listed as names only; variant values live here.
